narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating recorded $916M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating won 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $458M and obligations up 361.8% year over year. American Centrifuge Operating has built its FY2026 obligations largely in two NAICS markets: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing with $900M and Nuclear Electric Power Generation with $15.9M. Annual obligations have increased from $38.9M in FY21, to $42.9M in FY22, $50M in FY23, $85M in FY24, and $198M in FY25 before reaching $916M in FY26. The FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date and represent contract obligations unless otherwise noted. The concentration in Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing accounts for the vast majority of FY2026 obligations. Federal buyers and contract managers can use these figures to understand current award scale, market concentration, and the recent jump in obligations for American Centrifuge Operating.
